x: Archie Bedford ran his usual "gutty" race and passed the Aylesford man putting Jack Brown off second 50 seconds behind Laurie Reed S.L.H. junior.

This is the leg where the race can be won and lost, and names such as Hyman (who produced a fantastic new record - 34 seconds better than his own previous best), Wilkinson, Perry, North, Reed, Edmonds, Hogan and Foord appeared - enough to frighten the stoutest of hearts.
Alan almost repeated his excellent qualifying leap in the final rounds (24' 6") but was squeezed out of a 'bronze' by close rival Reed - by such margins are medals won and lost!
